brief: Cold email before and after AI. Reply rates, deal flow, time per campaign. The exact workflow that 4x'd my pipeline.

slots.title: Stop cold blasting
slots.description: The exact workflow that quadrupled my pipeline without adding headcount.

slots.title: Find ideal prospects
slots.description: Stop wasting hours on manual prospecting and outdated spreadsheets.
slots.badText: I manually scraped LinkedIn and filled spreadsheets for days.
slots.goodText: AI agents enrich leads with intent signals and verified emails.

slots.title: Personalize every touch
slots.description: Merge tags killed reply rates. AI writes unique openers per person.
slots.badText: Every email started with 'Hey {{First_Name}}' and zero context.
slots.goodText: AI crafts icebreakers from recent posts, hires, and tech stacks.

slots.title: Write sharp copy
slots.description: I test AI-generated variants instead of sending one generic template.
slots.badText: One static template went to thousands with no variation testing.
slots.goodText: AI spins five angles per persona and auto-picks the winner.

slots.title: Send smart sequences
slots.description: Timed follow-ups adapt to behavior instead of annoying every prospect.
slots.badText: I blasted a hundred emails daily with zero follow-up logic.
slots.goodText: Smart delays, reply detection, and auto-unsubscribe protect deliverability.

slots.title: Sort reply intent
slots.description: Hot leads drowned in notifications. Now AI tags intent instantly.
slots.badText: I missed warm replies inside a cluttered inbox for hours.
slots.goodText: An AI SDR labels intent, drafts replies, and books meetings.

slots.title: 4x your pipeline
slots.description: Lower cost per lead, faster replies, and a calendar full of demos.
slots.badText: High spend, low replies, and unpredictable deal flow every month.
slots.goodText: Automated outbound runs 24/7 and fills pipeline while I sleep.

slots.body: Steal the exact AI stack and workflow I used to 4x pipeline.
